rule: Interleave the reference arm with every candidate
reason: Session drift is ~10%; consecutive-boot drift is 0.07%. A carried-forward baseline is invisible to any same-batch check.

rule: Verify the baseline is stable across its own interleaved runs before quoting a ratio
reason: The 250k batches looked conclusive until this was done.

rule: Compare turn-matched prompts, not medians over different prompts
reason: Prompt difficulty otherwise dominates the ratio.

rule: For two-role workloads (cold prefill then replay) use the within-boot ratio t2/t1
reason: Identical requests ran 20% apart across boots.
error_it_prevented: Would have handed rci_pp=8192 a spurious 1.22x.

rule: Never quote a ratio before the last interleaved arm has finished
error_it_prevented: 250k was committed as 1.144x from boot 1 of 2; settled at ~1.06x, then parity.

rule: Verify time alignment before believing any time-correlated claim
reason: Two false correlations came from windows that did not map to the phase discussed.
error_it_prevented: Killed both the 'cache pressure' theory and the pagefile correlation.

rule: Sweep any knob whose benefit depends on a learned predictor across content categories
reason: Content changes the mechanism, not just the constants.
error_it_prevented: Would have caught that code is NOT MTP's best case.

rule: Any candidate must live-boot before being proposed
reason: The live server sits +1.7 to +2.5 GB above eval/perf.py on the same config; safe offline margin is ~2.5 GB, not the 200 MB guard.
error_it_prevented: mcs360 loads offline and will not boot the server.

rule: Predict every prompt variant before the first request at a new length
reason: actual = 0.2383*text + 294.4*msgs + 9,110. A variant over cache_size wastes a 65 s boot and looks like a config regression.
error_it_prevented: A 258k file would have been ~474k tokens and could never load.

rule: Capture anything suspected of being boot-level per boot
reason: The server log used to be <arm>.server.log, so every boot overwrote the last.
error_it_prevented: The only surviving 250k lead (CPU MoE arena reservation) was unreadable for exactly this reason.
